entities.name: Ervos Trax
entities.description: Marchesa's smuggler and business partner on Fiora, whose criminal empire stretched from the lowlands to Talon; he poisons himself rather than try to kill her.

entities.name: Marchesa
entities.description: Ervos's business partner and rival on Fiora, a master of poisons with zombie minions and countless agents.

entities.name: Fiora
entities.description: The plane where Ervos and Marchesa operate.

entities.name: Talon
entities.description: A city on Fiora within Ervos's criminal empire's reach.

entities.name: High City
entities.description: The noble district on Fiora to which Marchesa controls access.

entities.name: Pietro Lokosh
entities.description: Marchesa's sub-lieutenant, whom Ervos considered extorting.

events.summary: Over dinner at Marchesa's invitation, Ervos announces he has thought of having her killed and explains why every method would fail.
events.quote: Out of the blue, he told her he thought he would have her killed.

events.summary: Ervos reveals he has poisoned himself so that one of them dies on his own terms; he coughs up blood.
events.quote: it was apparent as he was coughing up blood, that Ervos had indeed poisoned himself, and was dying

events.summary: Marchesa reveals she had planned to have him killed in his sleep two nights later.
events.quote: revealed that she had planned to have him killed at his secret penthouse in his sleep two nights later

events.summary: Ervos slumps forward into his plate, dead.
events.quote: then slumped forward, face into his plate, dead.

events.summary: Marchesa leaves to summon her butler, who is already digging a hole for the body, having known all along that Ervos would take his own life.
events.quote: Marchesa had known all along that her rival would take his own life

relations.note: Business partners who were also rivals.
relations.quote: Ervos Trax was Marchesa 's smuggler and business partner on the plane of Fiora .

relations.note: Their businesses squared off and one would have to die.
relations.quote: one of them would have to die
